about: compiler/machinegraph: Data-Oriented state machine reachability, arm/alt matching, dead state/arm analysis, Tarjan SCC cycles, termination invariants, and checked source extraction.

mutants.name: selfhost-machinegraph-arms-past-whole
mutants.rule: ArmsFor stops immediately after the first non-partial arm matching (state, signal).

mutants.name: selfhost-machinegraph-alts-cross-product
mutants.rule: Multi-pattern tuple arms take only pairs matched by an individual Alt rather than the cross product.

mutants.name: selfhost-machinegraph-any-ignores-unknown
mutants.rule: Unknown decisions conservatively reach every state during reachability analysis.

mutants.name: selfhost-machinegraph-tarjan-misses-selfloop
mutants.rule: Single-state self-loops count as cycles in Tarjan SCC cycle detection.

mutants.name: selfhost-machinegraph-terminates-ignores-trapped
mutants.rule: A machine only AlwaysTerminates when no cycles exist and every reachable state can reach Done.

mutants.name: selfhost-machinegraph-source-partial-missed
mutants.rule: A record pattern with a non-wildcard field match marks the arm as partial.

mutants.name: selfhost-machinegraph-source-allows-impure-helper
mutants.rule: Only same-package helpers with an empty capability footprint may be inlined statically.

mutants.name: selfhost-machinegraph-source-empty-caselist
mutants.rule: A wildcard case _ clause (with empty pattern list) accepts every state and signal variant.

mutants.name: selfhost-machinegraph-analyze-misses-dead-end
mutants.rule: A reachable state with neither an outgoing state transition nor a Done exit is recorded in DeadEndStates.

mutants.name: selfhost-machinegraph-shadowed-arm-missed
mutants.rule: An arm never selected by ArmsFor for any (state, signal) pair is recorded in ShadowedArms.
